newsitem.title: UK: Eurostar managers face industrial action ballot.
newsitem.headline: Eurostar managers face industrial action ballot.

text.p: Eurostar, the cross Channel passenger rail service, said on Monday that 130 of its managers are facing a ballot on possible industrial action over pay.

A spokesman told Reuters that the managers were requesting more money and that a ballot was due to take place after on-going talks have failed. The ballot will not cover Eurostar drivers, said the company which is owned by the London and Continental Railways consortium -- including National Express Group Plc and Virgin.
A spokesman for Eurostar said it hoped that train services would not be hit.
The ballot is being organised by the rail industry union Aslef, which was not available immediately for comment on when the ballot will be held.
